test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

JOYS - YJOS - SYOJ

LAKE - KLAE - EKAL
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7876f7446fc1237e9ee664285ba9016dd4660e64989516f7ac5cec3be956421.png] 

Logic followed here is:Word 2 follows the letter order (3-1-2-4) and Word 3 follows the reverse order (4-3-2-1) of the first word.

**For**

**JOYS - YJOS - SYOJ →**

Word 2 (YJOS) rearrangement = Position (3), (1), (2), (4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bd026710c788c27dda17d0cb5eba3fbbdb9b50459efbe45ed45832d7cca1b27.png] 

Word 3 (SYOJ) rearrangement = Position (4), (3), (2), (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/680ee4a6a6bad01cd4ea780c5055680c894a94f0bd80d7e3119d1242038c8b9f.png] 

 

**LAKE - KLAE - EKAL →**

Word 2 (KLAE) rearrangement = Position (3), (1), (2), (4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5455bdf339c5e25caeca59dfdc57e9395f31c2516fae0087acaeebd789c962f5.png] 

Word 3 (EKAL) rearrangement = Position (4), (3), (2), (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41925ca90f0c4647b959ec7370c2231458e4aaba906e68c833fccbb8cf841f51.png] 

 

**Similarly, let's find the logic for QUAD - AQUD - DAUQ:**

Word 2 (AQUD) rearrangement = Position (3), (1), (2), (4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd7d1b614bde18b1382c97164d3a4243e23a6e14c84ce650a58d544687e62b2c.png] 

Word 3 (DAUQ) rearrangement = Position (4), (3), (2), (1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa192e3fc538ba5a998f978fb9e7115f6a4eca3b284f25af03e9fecc80d16272.png] 

Therefore, the triad that follows the same logic is QUAD - AQUD - DAUQ.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
